# Operational Hybrid Replanning V1

The architecture owner accepted this operational policy on 2026-10-05. It
implements the accepted Hybrid ownership without changing Student mastery
mathematics. Evidence truth and mastery remain Student-owned; significance and
consequences are Planner-owned; safe application and next action remain Student-owned.

## Coherent input

Planner reads the registered Student exact-path `student-planning-snapshot.v1`
with its dedicated Planner credential. Student observes path, profile, mastery,
immutable evidence provenance and protected bindings in one read-only PostgreSQL
repeatable-read transaction. The request names exact relevant target identities;
no raw evidence body, solution, lesson prose, private validation, prompt or token
crosses the boundary. Capture time and trigger trace do not change snapshot identity.

Planner classifies frozen `knowledge_check` as ASSESSMENT and validated
`application` as EXECUTION. Persisted Practice v2 surface `project` is PROJECT;
`practice` is EXECUTION. Theory acknowledgement is OBSERVATION only where an
actual Student fact exists. Unknown provenance is UNKNOWN and prohibits positive
automatic adaptation. Teacher assistance is support context, never objective evidence.

Stability counts the existing Student `independent_application` evidence kind,
using Course TaskID or Practice TaskInstanceID exactly as the Student reducer does.
Fewer than two applications is UNSTABLE; at least two applications across at least
two identities is DEVELOPING; at least three across at least two identities plus
MASTERED is STABLE. Incomplete provenance fails closed. IndependentSuccessCount
also counts quizzes and is not a substitute application count.

Confidence uses the existing accepted Planner policy threshold (current/default
0.80). This policy adds no decay, Bayesian model, new failure threshold or scoring
formula. The current Student confidence reaches 0.80 at eight objective evidence.

The new owner projection supports these deterministic Planner derivations.
Trigger, evaluator, durable consequence and application contracts are implemented
in later sequential T20 cards; snapshot reads themselves never mutate a path.

## Durable state trigger

Student commits `student.planning-state.changed.v1` with objective evidence/mastery
and its generic transactional outbox. Its existing envelope carries exact learner,
path, revision, trigger and bounded target identities. Targets are provenance
identities, never a score or mastery body. All relevant active paths receive facts;
selected context alone does not define scope. Theory, telemetry and Teacher hints
alone do not publish this fact.

Planner commits immutable inbox receipt and coalesced pending student/path work
before broker ACK. A separate worker fetches the current coherent snapshot and
refetches a union when current path targets are not yet covered. Generation and
claim fences prevent a newer event from being lost during that fetch. One unique
snapshot reference and V1 policy yields one durable evaluation job. Duplicate
receipt replay requires no owner read. At the trigger stage, no evaluator or path
application runs. Owner outage leaves durable work retryable.

Rollout order: provision canonical stream, apply owner migrations in isolation
and production rollout, then deploy producer and Planner consumer/worker.

### T20.2 actual proof

Root uses a dedicated native PostgreSQL proof cluster and isolated JetStream.
Registered Student v2 and legacy evidence ingress commit through real reducers;
the production relay publishes the retained committed planning fact. The actual
Planner consumer creates a durable inbox receipt before ACK, and its real worker
reads the registered Student coherent HTTP boundary and checkpoints that snapshot
in Planner PostgreSQL. Declared transport-only fixtures exercise bursts and lost
ACK after receipt commit. An actual refused HTTP connection exercises owner outage.
Neither trigger nor snapshot worker changes a Student path.

For fixture isolation, root postpones delivery metadata of unrelated retained
root-created outbox fixtures. It never writes final Evidence, Mastery or Path state
as a substitute for owner ingress. Snapshot and consequence phases remain separate.

## Deterministic consequences

Planner pins the existing active policy bundle and a bounded published prerequisite
projection before evaluation. An unavailable published graph is explicit; transport
or storage errors retry and do not become empty planning facts. Reconstructed workers
use retained pins. Pure evaluation has no network, LLM, consent or application port.

AUTO skips only redundant future PLANNED occurrences whose complete target set is
MASTERED at the accepted confidence threshold, EXECUTION/PROJECT quality and STABLE.
READY, IN_PROGRESS, completed/skipped history and RESERVED/OPEN Practice occurrences
remain protected. Existing graph policy may reorder already-frozen future slots to
satisfy a real prerequisite gap; one failure creates no new content or threshold.

An optional exact pending learner-intent projection contributes to the coherent
snapshot hash. Its absence preserves the earlier wire hashes. The one-pending-intent
selection rule is per exact path revision, with competing proposals rejected rather
than implicitly superseded. Major proposals carry REQUIRES_INTENT and complete exact
scope/intent provenance; only the later Student boundary can authorize/consume them.
No authoritative track identity exists in the current bounded profile, so track
proposals fail closed rather than deriving one from direction or free text.

Migration 021 retains immutable policy pins and semantic outcome receipts independently
of mutable evaluator leases. Storage reruns the pure evaluator against stored snapshot
and pins before accepting an outcome. Completion and lease termination commit together.
Exact replay returns the original receipt; changed payload conflicts. Rollback refuses
retained state, and UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE guards protect audit evidence.

## Durable Student application

Migration022 adds leased delivery work and immutable application results. The production delivery worker posts the exact stored consequence to the registered Student boundary with its dedicated Planner token. Only a strict APPLIED/NO_CHANGE Student receipt completes delivery; WAITING_SAFE_BOUNDARY and transient failures remain retryable. Lost responses resend the same consequence and recover the original owner receipt.

A typed Student HYBRID_STALE conflict records one local stale result and increments the existing snapshot-work generation. It preserves the real latest Student event and inbox; no synthetic Student fact is published. Snapshot target closure now includes exact path and known Course/Practice binding targets, with the same500-target technical limit.

Student032 must precede the optional pending-intent snapshot reader; Planner022 must precede delivery worker startup. Both down migrations refuse retained owner state. General Course and Teacher credentials cannot apply a Hybrid consequence or create learner consent. Scope/content transitions without an existing immutable template or authoritative mapping fail closed; no Runtime hold or Catalog selection policy is introduced.

## Composed verification (T20.5)

The root-only `TestT205ActualHybridComposed` consumes the real Student outbox event through canonical NATS/JetStream and the production Planner consumer, snapshot/evaluation/application processors and PostgreSQL stores. It reads the registered Student coherent snapshot, evaluates the real pinned policy/graph, applies through the registered Student boundary and reads the actual Student NextActionResolver. A–G cover a single failed Course application yielding NO_CHANGE, stable independent execution yielding future AUTO, exact redelivery, a genuine owner-snapshot stale race, OPEN Practice preservation and ordinary safe completion, exact learner intent and recovery after owner commit with a lost response.

`TestT205HybridOwnerProvider` is a finite integration provider, not a production endpoint. Named initial authored metadata enters owner creation APIs; completed history enters actual theory acknowledgement. Practice evidence envelopes, Course official outcome/Teacher independent context, the Runtime execution projection and trusted gateway identity headers are bounded upstream fixtures. The Course join uses the actual registered Teacher assistance NATS subscriber. Transport faults and delivery scheduling are proof instrumentation. Neither final Evidence/Mastery/Path truth nor immutable Planner jobs/outcomes are seeded. This is scoped owner-boundary verification; it does not claim full platform live E2E or actual Runtime validation execution.
